Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The study analyzes metaproteomes from a mock community (SIHUMIx) and human feces. While some workflows involved enrichment (reverse iodixanol gradient) or fractionation, the primary analyzed material across the majority of the 24 workflows was the total protein extract derived from cell lysis of the complex microbial communities, fitting the 'whole cell lysate' scope for metaproteomics.
